question: Which open raw-payload normalization PR should become the canonical landing path after proof and serialization blockers are resolved?
rationale: Two external PRs target the same canonical issue with different normalization shapes, and both are still proof-gated, so automation should not choose or mutate the landing path.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
